description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Meera Lebbay Rebupasam as Vice Chairman of the Eravur U/C
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman in a local authority (Eravur Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral procedures for local government, specifically the nomination and declaration of an elected official to fill a vacant position, which falls squarely under the Elections classification (Type 7).
